sentiment.summary: Coverage in the 30-day window is mostly constructive for the Ethereum ecosystem: Cointelegraph reported Goldman Sachs plans to acquire ETF manager NEOS, adding Ether-linked income funds, and that Fidelity filed with the SEC to add staking to its Ethereum ETF, keeping 85% of rewards in FETH with quarterly cash distributions. The Ethereum Foundation announced a Trillion Dollar Security grant to Freedom of the Press Foundation for WEBCAT and said pcaversaccio joined its board. CoinDesk reported Russia is moving to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether, and USDT, with a 300,000-ruble annual purchase limit for non-qualified investors. This is news/ecosystem sentiment, not investment advice.

tags.label: institutional ETFs
tags.why: Cointelegraph reported Goldman Sachs would acquire NEOS, adding a $30 billion ETF business that includes Ether-linked income funds, and that Fidelity filed with the SEC to add staking to its Ethereum ETF.

tags.label: ETF staking
tags.why: Cointelegraph reported Fidelity plans to add staking to its Ether fund, with 85% of rewards retained by FETH and quarterly cash distributions planned for investors.

tags.label: retail trading rules
tags.why: CoinDesk reported Russia is moving to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether, and USDT, while non-qualified investors face a 300,000-ruble annual purchase limit per intermediary.

tags.label: security grants
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation announced a Trillion Dollar Security grant allocation to Freedom of the Press Foundation to continue development of WEBCAT, an open-source tool for verifying that browser-served site code matches what developers published.

tags.label: foundation governance
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation said pcaversaccio joined its board, describing the person as a long-time Ethereum contributor, SEAL 911 co-founder and lead, and a member of the EF Silviculture Society.
